snapshot.runtime_lag_note: The published runtime was behind exact main during active concurrent writes; exact repository evidence was pinned separately.

verdict.summary: The broad identical-/wc canary produced substantial distinct durable work, real dynamically-unblocked successors, stale recoveries and surplus-capacity proposals. It does not pass the stress gate end-to-end because recovery ownership was not atomic under concurrency and the durable evidence model cannot compute global launch/idle/collision/useful-results-per-human-intervention ratios without missing ledgers/receipts. Production /w must remain gated.

prepared_ready_claim_coverage.method: Exhaustive opportunity-ID reconciliation of the 52 static READY lanes against coordination/opportunities/claims during this verification cycle. This is claim-path saturation, not proof of 52 human launches or 52 completed runs.

actual_chat_launch_count.reason: Claim/run evidence identifies work attempts but there is no complete canonical ledger of every /wc chat opened, including chats that lost a race or became idle before persisting an attempt.

global_idle_ratio.reason: The denominator of launched workers and durable IDLE_NO_SAFE_USEFUL_WORK outcomes is incomplete. A zero or percentage would be invented.

global_duplicate_substantive_execution_r.reason: Intentional complementary multi-perspective work and missing durable loser-attempt receipts prevent a trustworthy global duplicate-execution denominator.

global_collision_rate.reason: Winning claims persist, but live LOST_EXISTING/HOST_ERROR claim attempts are not yet automatically emitted as append-only receipts. Proposal P-04df793d0713-e1aaac9c was generated specifically for this gap.

surface_return_artifact_coverage_at_pinn.truth_ceiling: RETURN artifact coverage only; not terminal throughput or human acceptance.

mechanism_grades.evidence: All 52 static READY opportunity IDs had exclusive claim paths during the verification scan. This verifier also lost a create-if-absent race for control-plan integration without overwriting the winner, then reloaded and selected different work.
mechanism_grades.boundary: Does not establish total chat count or useful completion.

mechanism_grades.evidence: BLOCKED_DEPENDENCY successors were claimed only after live prerequisite evidence advanced: control-plan and alumnos local integrations acquired claims, and this stress verifier itself was claimed after all five gate dependencies had qualifying RETURN evidence; the recovered Kernel run was DONE at 09:58:11 before this verifier claim at 09:58:54.
mechanism_grades.boundary: Facultad/mobile remained blocked while declared prerequisite returns were missing; queue source status was not manually promoted.

mechanism_grades.evidence: The continuation implementation passed 8/8 tests including exactly-one-winner successor race, and live dynamically-unblocked successor claims occurred in the wave.
mechanism_grades.boundary: The inspected live receipts do not yet prove an end-to-end same-chat RETURN -> reload -> successor-claim sequence under the integrated production allocator.

mechanism_grades.evidence: Multiple durable proposal fingerprint pins and proposal artifacts exist. P-04df793d0713-e1aaac9c is a concrete evidence-backed proposal for host-integrated claim-attempt receipts and has a matching immutable fingerprint pin.
mechanism_grades.boundary: The discovery library's filesystem race passed, but the original implementation return explicitly left host-specific repository pin racing outside scope; this wave proves host pins exist, not a measured concurrent host-pin race rate.

mechanism_grades.evidence: Stale orphan recovery happened in live evidence, including the 41-minute metrics audit orphan and Kernel lifecycle recovery; original attempts were preserved and late/competing attempts were reconciled rather than deleted.
mechanism_grades.boundary: Recovery ownership itself was not safely exclusive under concurrency.

mechanism_grades.evidence: The Kernel incident produced four overlapping recovery claims. Two recovery allocators 29 seconds apart each recorded no active overlap before persisting, proving read-then-write overlap preflight is raceable. Three competing recovery runs later converged to BOUNDARY and one survivor emitted the RETURN, but convergence-after-race is not atomic ownership.
mechanism_grades.blocking_fix: Use one atomic durable recovery fence/create-if-absent key (or equivalent host uniqueness transaction) at ownership acquisition; caller-supplied refetch/overlap evidence remains advisory, not the exclusivity primitive.

mechanism_grades.evidence: The wave produced executable/tested components, surface returns, recovery returns, local-integration claims and reusable proposals. A pinned surface proxy showed 21/28 staged surface return directories.
mechanism_grades.boundary: Useful durable results per human intervention remains UNKNOWN because no canonical human-action denominator exists, and RETURN existence is not equivalent to terminal integration/usefulness.

mechanism_grades.evidence: Control Room has deterministic loader/fixture semantics for READY, working, stale, returned and blocked states.
mechanism_grades.boundary: Its own canary receipt says full live-repository snapshot wiring was not proven. Missing durable loser claim-attempt receipts and launch/idle ledger prevent complete stress ratios.

route_changing_findings.finding: The existing lease/retry decision primitive is insufficient as the live ownership boundary because its caller-supplied preflight evidence races under concurrent GitHub writes.

A lost normal claim race can disappear with the chat. The stress gate cannot reconstruct global collision/duplication rates until actual WON/LOST_EXISTING/HOST_ERROR outcomes are persisted automatically.
The repository cannot yet calculate actual worker-launch count, idle ratio or useful durable results per human intervention without guessing. Path counts are insufficient.
Multi-stage continuation is executable and tested, and downstream work unlocks live, but an integrated same-chat re-entry receipt is still needed before claiming the mechanism end-to-end.
